name: barbell close grip larsen press
description: A larsen press with a close grip: you bench with your feet off the floor, which removes leg drive and puts the work on chest and triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold the bar with a close, shoulder-width grip.
Lift your feet off the floor and stretch your legs out in front of you.
Lower the bar to your lower chest under control.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your back flat on the bench and your core tight throughout.
